procedure.en: Turn the adjustment dial clockwise until it cannot move further. That is the start point. Count clicks counter-clockwise from there.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire o ajuste no sentido horário até não se mover mais. Esse é o ponto inicial. Conte os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali.

notes: 80 µm per click is the burr travel Timemore lists for its older standard-burr grinders (Timemore knowledge base), not particle size. 12 clicks per rotation, about 36 clicks total. C2S shares burrs and clicks with C2. No manufacturer click ranges were found for the C2; every band is Honest Coffee Guide.
